# Who Is the Greatest International Soccer Striker of All Time?

The greatest-striker debate often leans on reputation and nostalgia. This project uses international goal data to compare the top candidates on volume, style, efficiency, and career consistency.

[Read the analysis](analysis.html){.btn .btn-light .btn-lg}
:::

::: {.grid .g-4 .mt-4}
::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### Why this question matters

It is not just about most goals. It is about who built the strongest case across a full international career.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6}
### What the site examines

The analysis compares totals, open-play scoring, efficiency, and career shape to make the debate more evidence-based.
